notes: «وقال مرة عبد الله وقال مرة محمد» gives other first names for the same ابن أبي المجالد: left out, the name is kept as written
«فأرسلوني إلى ابن أبي أوفى فسألته» : the one asked and answering is a link in his own place (rule 6); Abu Burda and Abdullah b. Shaddad are in the scene only
«وسألت ابن أبزى فقال مثل ذلك» is a second answer with its own transmitter: not read as a route; ruling needed (rule 11)
